svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SE05x: Recommended application (SE050, SE051)
svg.desc: Schematic of the SE05x recommended application (se050, se051): the chip with U2 MCU, C1 capacitor 100 nF, R1 resistor 3.3 kΩ, R2 resistor 3.3 kΩ; the MCU wires carry the port hooks SetEnable() / PowerCycle(), Write() / Read().
svg.text: The chip on an MCU's I2C bus with pull-ups, ENA on a GPIO the reset port drives, and VOUT wired to VCC so that ENA low
switches the core off: the only power cycle the driver can make, and the only cure of errata I2C.1 and I2C.2. RST_N is tied to
VSS (allowed by Table 5): it has no effect with I2C alone, and VCC is switched off in deep power-down. Above each MCU
wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 5.2 Deep Power-down mode, p. 10.
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: C1 100 nF: a usual decoupling value; the SE050 data sheet gives none.
